resources.string: Same layout: copy the whole gallery. Other layout: convert. Missing pages are allowed.

A new layout for your galleries
Choose two separate folders and a target layout, then scan to preview every action.
Entirely on your device. Original files stay intact.
Review the plan, then start your batch.
Place gallery folders directly inside the input folder. Each gallery needs its own folder.
Completed galleries are kept. Scan again to retry unfinished items.

EhBridge processes only first-level gallery folders named GID-title.

A: .ehviewer, numeric page files (at least 8 digits), one thumb/ thumb.* cover and ComicInfo.xml.

B: GID.cbz, one original cover and external ComicInfo.xml. The ZIP root must contain page files and ComicInfo.xml.

Page gaps and arbitrary extensions are allowed. Images are never decoded or recompressed. The original input is read only. Existing output folders are skipped.

B → A writes real CBOR SpiderInfo. Missing gallery tokens do not stop conversion, but EhViewer may be unable to restore its download list or resume online downloads. Reading position and page tokens cannot be recovered.

Target EhViewer binary compatibility still requires a real .ehviewer sample and device check; the supplied decoded JSON only confirms field semantics.

A visible foreground task keeps processing when the screen is off. Android may stop a task after its background time limit. Cancel or interrupted outputs are cleaned when possible; a .partial folder or .ehbridge-incomplete marker identifies unfinished output.

Reports contain relative gallery/file names and status, never gallery tokens, XML contents or tree URIs.
Not a first-level folder named positive-GID-title.
A required file is missing or is not a regular file.
No numeric page file was found. Missing some pages is allowed.
Conflicting main layouts, duplicate names or multiple covers.
Unknown data has no safe destination in the target layout.
The archive GID differs from the gallery folder GID.
Unreadable or unsafe ZIP: invalid paths, duplicates, encryption, unsupported compression, corruption or excessive expansion.
Page index exceeds the safe range of 1–100000.
The output name or GID is already occupied. Skipped without overwriting.
Read/write failed. Check folder permissions, available space and the storage provider.
Could not write and decode the generated CBOR .ehviewer file.
Input and output must be different folders and cannot contain each other.
Cannot verify that these folders are separate. Choose both folders from the same provider with ancestry support.
Folder access is unavailable. Please choose the folder again.
Cancelled. Completed galleries are kept; unfinished output is cleaned when possible.
The input structure changed after scanning. Scan again.
Offline files restored. No gallery access token is available; EhViewer download-list recovery or online resume may be limited.
External and internal XML tokens differ. The external token takes priority.
Internal and external ComicInfo.xml differ. The external XML is preserved.
Page gaps or fewer files than the expected page count. Existing pages are still processed.
CBZ cannot retain .ehviewer download state. Page files, cover and XML are preserved.
An unfinished temporary output could not be removed. Remove this relative output folder manually after the task stops.
External XML is invalid or too large for metadata extraction. Its original bytes are preserved; minimal SpiderInfo is used.
